Continue existing delivery containment and failure-repair review. Before any dispatch or requeue, require dated ownership, root cause, isolated validation, rollback, release, deduplication, security, attribution, and measurement evidence. Do not create or requeue new implementation work.

Do not access credentials or private containers, alter permissions or configuration, add dependencies, deploy, exploit targets, or conduct external outreach.

Retain the existing period-aligned revenue, attribution, and cost reconciliation only. Preserve the $4.92 aggregate provider commission for 2026-09-21 as unattributed. Do not infer site revenue, margin, ROI, payback, budget capacity, cost-to-learn, forecasts, or causal lift.
